R="/opt/redis-8.10/bin/redis-cli -p 6379"; for db in 0 2; do echo db$db; $R -n $db --scan | while read k; do $R -n $db type "$k"; done | sort | uniq -c; done; $R info modules; $R config get databases; valkey-cli -p 6380 config get databases
python3 -c "import redis; print(redis.__version__)"; python3 --version; pip list 2>/dev/null | grep -i -E "redis|valkey"

cat > /tmp/survey.py <<'EOF'
import redis
r=redis.Redis(port=6379)
for db in (0,2):
    r.execute_command('SELECT',db)
    c=redis.Redis(port=6379,db=db)
    odd=[k for k in c.scan_iter(count=1000) if not k.isascii() or b' ' in k or b'\n' in k]
    print(db,'odd keys',odd[:10],len(odd))
    for k in c.scan_iter(count=1000,_type='stream'):
        print(k, c.execute_command('XINFO','STREAM',k,'FULL'))
        break
    n=0
    for k in c.scan_iter(count=1000,_type='hash'):
        t=c.execute_command('HTTL',k,'FIELDS',c.hlen(k),*c.hkeys(k))
        if any(x!=-1 for x in t):
            n+=1
            if n<2: print(k,t, c.hgetall(k))
    print('hashes with field ttl',n)
    print('total',c.dbsize())
EOF
python3 /tmp/survey.py 2>&1 | cut -c1-3000

cat > /tmp/s2.py <<'EOF'

c=redis.Redis(port=6379)
for k in sorted(c.scan_iter(_type='stream')):
    i=c.execute_command('XINFO','STREAM',k,'FULL','COUNT',1)
    g=i[b'groups']
    print(k,i[b'length'],i[b'last-generated-id'],i[b'max-deleted-entry-id'],i[b'entries-added'],i[b'recorded-first-entry-id'],c.pttl(k),len(g))
    if g: print('  ',g)
print([ (k,c.object('encoding',k)) for k in list(c.scan_iter(_type='string'))[:5]])
EOF
